definitions.explanation: a road or path that goes up or down a slope

examples.japanese: この{坂道|さかみち}は{急|きゅう}だ。
{自転車|じてんしゃ}で{坂道|さかみち}を{下|くだ}る。
examples.english: To go down a hill by bicycle.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{坂道|さかみち}を{歩|ある}いて{疲|つか}れた。
examples.english: I got tired from walking up the long hill.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}までの{道|みち}には{坂道|さかみち}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many slopes on the way to school.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {坂道|さかみち}を{登|のぼ}る (to climb a slope)
- {坂道|さかみち}を{下|くだ}る / {下|お}りる (to go down a slope)
- {急|きゅう}な{坂道|さかみち} (steep slope)
- {緩|ゆる}やかな{坂道|さかみち} (gentle slope)

RELATED WORDS:
- {坂|さか} (slope, hill)
- {上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか} (uphill slope)
- {下|くだ}り{坂|ざか} (downhill slope)
- {峠|とうげ} (mountain pass)

NOTE:
Japan has many famous named slopes ({坂|さか}), especially in Tokyo and other hilly cities.
